title: Ensure snippet custom content remains legible

statement.en: Ensure a snippet's custom content remains legible against the system background.
statement.ja: snippetのcustom contentをsystem backgroundに対して読みやすく保つ。

conditions: Check sufficient contrast in both light and dark appearances.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Snippets experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
